title: Amren's Family Sword
description: Amren asks the player to recover his father's sword from thieves.

base_facts: My father's sword was stolen by thieves.
I want capable help recovering my father's sword.

QUEST_ACCEPTED: The player has explicitly committed to recovering my father's sword from the thieves who stole it.
I have entrusted the recovery of my family heirloom to this person.
I am now waiting for the player to return with my father's sword.
Recovering the sword would restore a treasured family heirloom that was taken from me.

beats.comment: The player clearly agrees to recover Amren's family sword.
beats.intent_summary: Player commits to recovering Amren's father's sword.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to recover Amren's father's sword.
examples_yes: I will get your sword back.
I can recover your father's sword.
